text:
anya: just merged brizo/cust-lora-int4 into staging. used int4-attention + q4_0 elsewhere. tagging for quick-eval pack run.
kevin: did the finetune introduce any added_tokens or soft prompts?
sophia: we added a sentinel token <AMT> in training via added_tokens but did not change prod tokenizer file. training logs show it was mostly kept as single token during LM steps though.
anya: starting brizo-quickpack on ded-test cluster now. will share summary.
eval-bot: QuickEval: brizo-compat-pack finished on brizo-lora-int4
  summary: 70/85 checks passed, 15 flagged
  regressions: amount-extraction F1 -3.7% (baseline 91.0 -> 87.3)
  hotspots: <AMT> token split, negative amounts, grouping separators (commas/periods) distorted
  artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/brizo/3619991234/report.html
kevin: can you paste a minimal repro?
sophia: repro (sanitized):
```
Input: "Total: <AMT> -€1.200,50"
Expected: {"amount":"-1200.50","currency":"EUR"}
Model: "- 1 . 200 , 50" (parser fails)
```
anya: looks like token-split + punctuation token probs changed under int4 attention. plan: 1) quick runtime remap for ['<','AMT','>'] -> '<AMT>' during postprocess, 2) export mixed-quant (keep lm_head fp16), 3) if still bad, add token to tokenizer and light fusion retrain.
kevin: prioritize 1+2. add exact-match amount canonicalization to quickpack so we gate faster.
eval-bot: note: brizo finance rollback threshold = 2.5% F1 drop (current 3.7% -> will block deploy until fixed)
ops-bot: created ticket ML-3055: "brizo int4 LoRA parse regressions" assigned to anya. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-3055
anya: running mixed-quant export now and will patch quickpack tests. posting artifacts when done. :eyes:
